mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates during monetary easing cycles, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods of declining FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous UNRATE increase and PAYEMS decline signal labor market deterioration, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in less than 40% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and PAYEMS falls > 50k.

mechanism_narrative: High GDP growth regimes (annualized GDPC1 growth > 3%) support corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate > 3% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment rates (UNRATE > 5.0%) correlate with weak consumer spending and lower corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.0% signals severe labor market contraction that depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent INDPRO decline and CPIAUCSL rise indicate stagflationary pressures, increasing equity risk premiums and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in less than 40% of instances where INDPRO falls > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial growth regimes (annualized INDPRO growth > 2%) support manufacturing activity and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO growth rate > 2% annualized.
